claims.text: The Althing, Iceland's national assembly, first met in AD 930.
The Althing is not the assembly of Norway, Denmark or Sweden, whose parliaments are the Storting, the Folketing and the Riksdag.
The Althing first met in the open air at Thingvellir (Þingvellir).
Thingvellir lies in a rift valley where the North American and Eurasian plates are moving apart.
